dropped_findings.text: Threats are listed by component, not by risk. The accepted MVP spoofing exposure (T-5) and the medical-history leak (T-2) do not lead the list.

findings.text: C12 cites a design-step IDE answer (A-11), but threat.md has no answers: list, so the cross-step answer cite will fail H4. The answer also only says 'lastVisitAt, ISO UTC'. It does not support the 'or null' part of the claim.
